items.summaryEn: Lando Norris won praise from Formula 1 fans after firmly rejecting a request to put away a can of Coca-Cola in the cooldown room following the Spanish Grand Prix.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯因在西班牙大奖赛后对可口可乐要求做出坚决回应而获赞：“马德林赛道的高光时刻”
兰多·诺里斯在冷却室坚决拒绝将一罐可口可乐收起来的要求后，赢得了F1车迷的赞扬。
在西班牙大奖赛赛后，兰多·诺里斯拒绝了官员提出的不要在冷却室饮用可口可乐的要求，F1车迷对此表示赞赏。
这位2025年世界冠军在马德林赛道举行的首届比赛中获得第三名，他原本舒适的领先优势因时机不佳的虚拟安全车而丧失。
从杆位发车后，诺里斯在开局阶段对梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利建立了可观的优势。但当阿斯顿·马丁车手兰斯·斯特罗尔在第20弯停下时，他的比赛发生了变化。
虚拟安全车在诺里斯刚过维修区入口后不久出动，迫使这位迈凯伦车手多跑一圈慢速圈，而安东内利和红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘则利用便宜的进站机会获益。
安东内利最终赢得大奖赛，扩大了他在积分榜上的领先优势。
赛后，诺里斯被看到在冷却室喝一罐可口可乐。该饮料品牌是迈凯伦的赞助商，但不是F1的合作伙伴。事实上，F1与可口可乐最大的竞争对手百事可乐有合作关系。
当一名官员要求他把饮料收起来时，诺里斯坚决回应：“我刚比完赛，所以我可以喝我想喝的。非常感谢。”
这一时刻迅速在社交媒体上传播，许多车迷赞扬这位英国车手的回应。
“这就是马德林赛道的高光时刻，”一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，另一位补充说：“讽刺的是，他们试图阻止他，反而让更多人关注到了这件事。”
“喜欢这个版本的兰多。基米向马克斯和兰多学习媒体应对会很有趣，”另一个人发帖说，还有一位车迷评论道：“马克斯下一场比赛会带着一打红牛出现。我喜欢这个兰多。”
“合理的反应，在那场该死的比赛中被那样搞了之后，”另一条评论写道。
进一步的评论包括：“就是这样，兰多！为他高兴，”以及“完全支持兰多的怼人。天气很热。他累了，今天过得很糟。他没有展示标签。让这个人享受一下。”
detailEn: Lando Norris praised for firm response to Coca-Cola request after Spanish GP: "Highlight of the Madring"
Lando Norris won praise from Formula 1 fans after firmly rejecting a request to put away a can of Coca-Cola in the cooldown room
Formula 1 fans have praised Lando Norris after he shot down a request from an official not to drink Coca-Cola in the cooldown room after the Spanish Grand Prix.
The 2025 champion finished third in the inaugural race at the Madring circuit, having lost a comfortable lead due to an ill-timed virtual safety car.

After starting from pole position, Norris had built a decent advantage over Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli during the opening stint. But his race changed when Aston Martin driver Lance Stroll stopped at Turn 20.

The virtual safety car was deployed moments after Norris had passed the pit entry, forcing the McLaren driver to complete a slow lap while Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen capitalised on cheap pitstops.
Antonelli went on to win the grand prix, extending his championship lead.

Following the race, Norris was seen in the cooldown room drinking a can of Coca-Cola. The drink brand is a sponsor of McLaren, but it is not a partner of F1. In fact, F1 has a partnership with Coca-Cola's biggest rival, PepsiCo.
When he was asked by an official to put the drink away, Norris firmly responded: "I just did a race, so I'm allowed to drink what I would like. Thank you so much."
The moment quickly made its way across social media, with many fans praising the Briton for his response.
"THIS is the highlight of the Madring," one fan commented on Reddit, while another added: "The irony is their attempt to stop him has brought so many more eyes on this."

"Love this version of Lando. Kimi learning media from Max and Lando will be hilarious," someone else posted, and another fan commented: "Max will be turning up with a six-pack of Red Bull next race. I like this Lando."
"Valid reaction, after getting f***ed like that in that DAMNED race," another comment read.
Further comments included: "Exactly like that, Lando! Good for him," and "Fully support Lando’s sass. It was hot. He’s tired and having a bad day. He isn’t showing labels. Let the man have a treat."
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯从杆位发车，但在虚拟安全车时机不佳后失去领先优势，最终获得第三名。
可口可乐是迈凯伦的赞助商，但不是F1的合作伙伴，F1与可口可乐的竞争对手百事可乐有合作。
诺里斯回应官员称：“我刚比完赛，所以我可以喝我想喝的。非常感谢。”

Coca-Cola is a sponsor of McLaren but not a partner of F1; F1 has a partnership with Coca-Cola's rival PepsiCo.
Norris responded to the official: "I just did a race, so I'm allowed to drink what I would like. Thank you so much."

items.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛赢家与输家盘点
items.summaryZh: The 比赛团队对2026年F1西班牙大奖赛进行赢家与输家盘点，指出在马德里赛道的首场F1比赛中真正的赢家不多，连获胜者本人都觉得自己应该排在第二位。
items.originalTitle: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛的赢家与输家
items.summaryEn: The Race team reviews the winners and losers from the 2026 Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, noting that there were not many true winners at the first F1 race at the Madring, and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.
detailZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛没有多少赢家——甚至真正的比赛获胜者都觉得自己其实应该排在第二位。
以下是我们完整的赢家与输家盘点。
一场本应赢下的比赛，因此也不应该有一辆车只拿到第八名。真是办公室里的艰难一天。
虚拟安全车让赛道上除兰多·诺里斯之外的每辆车都获得了优势，这是唯一的问题。他开得几乎完美，擦到7号弯护墙是他唯一的瑕疵，看起来他已经稳操胜券，却在之后被夺走。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的比赛要复杂得多。第一圈与乔治·拉塞尔碰撞导致的受损前翼到底对他有多大影响？而他在最后阶段被加布里埃尔·博托莱托和弗兰科·科拉平托挡在身后，究竟该归咎于他缺乏速度、进站，还是迈凯伦的策略团队？车队选择让他进站，明知他可能被困在那群车中。
皮亚斯特里在2026款赛车上相对诺里斯一直很挣扎，但即便在这种情况下，这个周末也感觉很糟糕。——杰克·贝尼昂
刘易斯·汉密尔顿起步时确实没有犯错。他起步比马克斯·维斯塔潘快，荷兰人在切过开场减速弯后最终不得不让出位置。
随后长长的刹车踏板行程迅速变成故障，汉密尔顿不得不停下他的法拉利。
“进入5号弯刹车时，我踩了刹车，车开始减速，然后踏板突然一沉，车没有像正常那样快速减速，我最终带着很高的速度冲了进去……擦到了护墙。”
“之后踏板恢复了，一切正常，但几个弯之后踏板又变长了。真的不知道这是从哪里来的，”这是汉密尔顿的事后分析。
本可能是领奖台的成绩变成了退赛，这位车手随后承认安东内利在冠军争夺中不可阻挡。
考虑到迈凯伦的研发速度，这对法拉利来说可能是一次刺痛的积分损失——他们在争夺年度亚军的优势现在缩小到了52分。——萨马斯·卡纳尔
又一场比赛，又一个冠军给基米·安东内利——又一次利用了虚拟安全车。
安东内利这次不需要在赛道上超车，因为首先杆位得主诺里斯的比赛因虚拟安全车出动时机稍晚而崩盘，他晚一圈的进站也很慢。
然后查尔斯·勒克莱尔因放弃了虚拟安全车期间的进站，不得不在比赛后期让出领先位置。
低轮胎磨损、缺乏超车机会以及迈凯伦不幸的时机和糟糕的策略，使这场比赛成为安东内利本赛季最不引人注目的胜利。
他在胜利中表现得很有风度，说他为诺里斯“感到有点难过”，并称这位迈凯伦车手本应是当之无愧的赢家。
凭借这场胜利，梅赛德斯追平法拉利，成为动力单元制造商中大奖赛胜场最多的品牌（251胜）。
更重要的是，安东内利目前积292分，而队友乔治·拉塞尔为211分。
他有望以相当大的优势成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。——SK
这位马德里赛道赛事大使从未期待过一场特别有竞争力的主场比赛，但他本希望周日不会像这样充满事故。
第一圈开始，他笨拙地撞上了角田裕毅的小红牛，随后又将同胞费尔南多·阿隆索挤到墙上。
幸运的是，卡洛斯·塞恩斯至少能在退赛前服完处罚——所以不会带到巴库——但这为这个令人失望且草率的周末画上了句号。——乔什·萨蒂尔
在蒙扎的最坏情况之后，人们曾希望马德里赛道能为阿斯顿·马丁提供一个更好的机会，像在赞德沃特那样争夺积分。
但这从未实现，也看起来不太可能。他肯定没有得到帮助，因为阿隆索被塞恩斯挤压后带着损伤，这使得很难知道阿斯顿·马丁在这里的真实潜力。
“今天引擎非常糟糕，”阿隆索说。“我认为今天的增压控制很困难。我在进站时差点熄火。”
“还有蓝旗的时候，让车减速。引擎在那之后很难恢复，所以我在蓝旗上损失了很多时间。”
他最终落后两圈，以第17名完赛，而兰斯·斯特罗尔在57圈比赛的第15圈就驶离了赛道。——JS
科拉平托以第七名领跑中游集团，表现稳健。
他带领一列中游赛车在斯特罗尔引发的虚拟安全车期间进站，然后在最后阶段向博托莱托施压并挡住了皮亚斯特里。
虽然一度与皮亚斯特里的差距是三秒——科拉平托在压力下面对一辆快得多的赛车时巧妙地扩大了差距——但差距在最后确实缩小了。但这并不改变这一成就的分量。
科拉平托现在在车手积分榜上仅落后第11名的阿尔维德·林德布拉德四分，而阿尔派在争夺车队第五名时与小红牛的差距已从13分缩小到9分。——JB
马德里赛道这个周末做了很多正确的事，但很难将首场F1比赛描述为除了沉闷之外的任何东西。
赛道缺乏超车机会肯定没有帮助，缺乏显著的轮胎磨损也没有帮助。
但也许最痛苦的是，这正是许多F1车手在布局公布时警告会发生的情况。
所以，尽管马德里赛道做了很多伟大的事情，首届赛事最可能被记住的，是它令人失望的周日产品。——JS
detailEn: Not many winners from Formula 1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix - and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.
Here's our full winners and losers rundown.
A race it should have won, and therefore not had a car finishing eighth in, either. A really tough day at the office.

The VSC giving an advantage to every other car on track apart from Lando Norris was the sole issue. He drove almost perfectly, a clip of the Turn 7 wall his only blemish as he appeared to have the race sewn up before it was taken from him.

Oscar Piastri's race was much more complicated. How much did the damaged wing from clashing with George Russell on lap one really hamper him? And was it his lack of pace, the pitstop, or McLaren's strategy bods to blame for him being caught behind Gabriel Bortoleto and Franco Colapinto in the closing stages? It chose to pit him, knowing being stuck in that pack was a possibility.
Piastri has struggled relative to Norris with the 2026 car, but this felt like a poor weekend even in the circumstances. - Jack Benyon
Lewis Hamilton didn't really put a foot wrong at the start. He was quicker than Max Verstappen off the line and the Dutchman did eventually have to concede after cutting the opening chicane.
Then a long brake pedal quickly turned into a malfunction and Hamilton had to stop his Ferrari.

"Braking into Turn 5, I had hit the brake, the car started stopping and then the pedal took a step and the car didn't decelerate as fast as it would normally and I ended up carrying a lot of speed in and… brushed the barrier.
"After that, the pedal came back, it was fine, and then a few corners later the pedal went long. Don't really know where that's come from," was Hamilton's post-mortem.
What could have been a podium finish turned into a DNF for the driver, who then conceded that Antonelli was unstoppable in the title race.
Given McLaren's rate of development, it could prove to be a stinging points loss for Ferrari - whose advantage in their fight for second in the championship is now down to 52 points. - Samarth Kanal
Another race, another win for Kimi Antonelli - and another VSC capitalised upon.
Antonelli didn't need to make an overtake on track for this one, as first polesitter Norris's race unravelled as the VSC was deployed a moment too late and his pitstop one lap later was slow.
Then Charles Leclerc had to relinquish the lead late in the race having forgone the VSC pitstop.
Low tyre degradation, a lack of overtaking opportunities and McLaren's unfortunate timing and poor strategy made this one Antonelli's least remarkable win of the season.
He was gracious in victory, saying he "felt a bit bad" for Norris and that the McLaren driver would've been the deserving winner.
With victory here, Mercedes has tied Ferrari for most grand prix wins by a power unit manufacturer (251).
More consequentially, Antonelli is on 292 points to team-mate George Russell's 211.
He's on course to become F1's youngest world champion by some margin. - SK
The Madring event ambassador was never expecting a particularly competitive home grand prix, but he'd have hoped for better than an incident-filled Sunday.
It began on lap one with a rather clumsy first lap where he clunked into Yuki Tsunoda's Racing Bulls, and was followed by squeezing his fellow countryman Fernando Alonso into the wall.
Thankfully Carlos Sainz was at least able to serve that penalty before he retired - so it won't carry over to Baku - but it rounded off a disappointing and sloppy weekend. - Josh Suttill
After the worst-case scenario at Monza, there was hope the Madring would provide a better chance for Aston Martin to challenge for points like at Zandvoort.

But it never materialised nor looked likely. He certainly wasn't helped by Alonso carrying damage from Sainz squeezing him, and that makes it particularly hard to know the true potential of the Aston Martin here.
"The engine was very bad today," Alonso said. "I think the boost control was difficult today. I nearly stalled on the pitstops.
"With some of the blue flags as well, letting the people go and slowing down. The engine was struggling to recover after that, so I was losing a lot of time on the blue flags.
He ultimately finished two laps down in 17th while Lance Stroll pulled off the track 15 laps into the 57-lap race. - JS
Colapinto led the midfield with an accomplished drive to seventh.
He led a train of mid-pack cars that pitted under the Stroll-induced VSC, and then pressured Bortoleto and held off Piastri in the closing stages.

While the gap was three seconds at one point to Piastri - expertly extended by Colapinto under pressure from what was a much quicker car - it did come down towards the end. But that doesn't change the scale of the achievement.

Colapinto's only four points off 11th-placed Arvid Lindblad in the drivers' championship now, and Alpine's gap to Racing Bulls in the chase for fifth in the constructors' has reduced from 13 to nine. - JB
The Madring did plenty right this weekend, but it's difficult to describe the first F1 race as anything but dull.
The lack of overtaking opportunities around the circuit certainly didn't help, nor did the lack of significant tyre degradation.
But what's perhaps most painful is that this is exactly what many F1 drivers warned would happen when the layout was revealed.
So for all the great things the Madring has done, the first event will most likely be best remembered for its underwhelming Sunday product. - JS

detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格：卡洛斯·塞恩斯必须为马德里赛道赛道超车问题分担责任
尼科·罗斯伯格表示，卡洛斯·塞恩斯必须为马德里新建马德里赛道赛道缺乏超车机会承担部分责任。
2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格表示，鉴于卡洛斯·塞恩斯作为马德里马德里赛道赛道形象大使的角色，他必须为该赛道缺乏超车机会承担部分责任。
2026年西班牙大奖赛在位于马德里IFEMA展览中心周边的新建半永久性赛道举行，取代了巴塞罗那-加泰罗尼亚赛道。但在梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利庆祝其本赛季第八个大奖赛胜利后，该赛道缺乏超车机会立即遭到批评，认为其导致了列队式比赛。
赛后，罗斯伯格在天空体育F1节目中坚称，该赛道布局必须在2027年进行修改。
“卡洛斯·塞恩斯是形象大使，所以我们需要批评卡洛斯·塞恩斯，”罗斯伯格说。“他们需要为明年重新审视赛道布局，创造一个良好的超车机会。我们在这条赛道上需要这一点，因为超车实在太难了。”
罗斯伯格指出，迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里尽管拥有轮胎优势，却难以超越阿尔派车手弗兰科·科拉平托。
“这相当令人震惊。比如皮亚斯特里对科拉平托。皮亚斯特里拥有新轮胎，却无法超越。而且他快得多。超车就是超级难，”他补充道。
前阿斯顿·马丁策略师、天空体育F1分析师伯尼·柯林斯也批评了超车机会的缺乏。
当被问及车手是否应该对新赛道有更多发言权时，柯林斯解释道：“当赛道全部设计完成后，你应该去找他们并提出问题。但我认为在现阶段并不一定需要车手来说这些，不是吗？我们所有人来到这里，看着赛道都说，‘这将会非常难以超车。’
“所以我认为本应该采取一些措施来解决这个问题。现在他们非常开放地表示将在未来做出改变。他们乐于在未来做出改变。那不是一条永久性赛道。因此，我希望其中的一项改变是，如果可能的话，他们将在超车方面做出一些改进。”
detailEn: Nico Rosberg: Carlos Sainz must share blame for Madring overtaking issues
Nico Rosberg says Carlos Sainz must take some responsibility for the lack of overtaking at Madrid’s new Madring circuit
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg says Carlos Sainz must take some responsibility for the lack of overtaking at the new Madring circuit, given his role as ambassador for the venue.

The 2026 Spanish Grand Prix was hosted at a new semi-permanent track around the IFEMA exhibition centre in Madrid, moving away from the Barcelona-Catalunya circuit. But after Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli celebrated his eighth grand prix win of the season, the track’s lack of overtaking opportunities was immediately criticised for resulting in processional racing.
Speaking on Sky Sports F1 after the race, Rosberg insisted that the layout must be revised for 2027.

“Carlos Sainz was the ambassador, so we need to criticise Carlos Sainz,” Rosberg said. “They need to revisit the track layout for next year and create one good overtaking opportunity. We need that on this track because it's just too hard to overtake.”
Rosberg pointed to McLaren’s Oscar Piastri struggling to pass Alpine’s Franco Colapinto despite a tyre advantage.
“It was pretty shocking. Piastri on Colapinto, for example. Piastri had fresh tyres, he could not get past. And he was so much quicker. It's just super hard to overtake,” he added.
Former Aston Martin strategist and Sky F1 analyst Bernie Collins also criticised the lack of overtaking opportunities.

“When you get the circuit all designed, you should go to them and ask the questions,” Collins explained when asked if the drivers should have more of an input into new circuits. “But I don't think it necessarily needed a driver to say that at this stage, did it? We all got here, we all looked at the track and said, ‘That's going to be very difficult for overtaking.’

“So I think that there should have been something done to do that. Now they have been very open to say they will make changes going forward. They're happy to make changes going forward. That's not a permanent track. So one of those changes, I would hope, is that they're going to make some differences in overtaking if they can.”
keyPointsZh: 2026年西班牙大奖赛在位于马德里IFEMA展览中心周边的新建半永久性赛道举行，取代了巴塞罗那-加泰罗尼亚赛道。
梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利赢得该场比赛，这是他本赛季第八个大奖赛胜利。
前阿斯顿·马丁策略师、天空体育F1分析师伯尼·柯林斯也批评了赛道超车机会不足，并指出赛道方已表示愿意在未来做出改变。

items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛上，拉塞尔连续第五次被梅赛德斯队友安东内利击败，他赢得2026年F1年度冠军的可能性被形容为“极其渺茫”。

media.altZh: 拉塞尔2026年F1争冠希望愈发渺茫

items.originalTitle: 拉塞尔2026年F1争冠希望愈发渺茫
items.summaryEn: George Russell is now "exceptionally unlikely" to win the 2026 Formula 1 title after being beaten by Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli for a fifth consecutive time at the Spanish Grand Prix. At F1's new Madring track, Russell qualified a lowly sixth, explaining he "tried pushing hard in Turn 11" but "the tyres couldn't take it."
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔比以往任何时候都更接近放弃2026年F1总冠军的希望
拉塞尔目前落后队友安东内利81分，他明白除非出现奇迹，否则他的争冠希望已无可能挽回
乔治·拉塞尔目前“极不可能”赢得2026年一级方程式总冠军，在西班牙大奖赛上，他已经是连续第五次败给梅赛德斯队友安东内利了。
拉塞尔在F1全新的马德里赛道上仅排位第六，他解释说他“在11号弯尝试全力推进”，但“轮胎承受不住”。
他和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在比赛起步时发生了接触，这位英国车手似乎毫发无损，但他却在早段虚拟安全车出现时吃了亏——当时他正从硬胎换成中性胎，而他的大多数对手都在理想时机从软胎或中性胎换成了硬胎。
“安全车的时机实在太让人沮丧了，”拉塞尔说。“我们原本希望能撑到第40圈，我们知道基米以及用中性胎和软胎的车手大概会在第15圈左右进站，结果安全车在第14圈就出现了，所以……”
在12位以硬胎起跑的车手中，只有两人在虚拟安全车期间进站，那就是拉塞尔和阿隆索；前者最终又再次进站，换回了他偏好的硬胎配方。
夏尔·勒克莱尔在比赛前段一直跑在这辆梅赛德斯的正前方，他选择留在外面，直到第48圈才进站。尽管这辆银箭多进了一次站，而法拉利换上了新的软胎，勒克莱尔在比赛尾声仍然受到了这辆梅赛德斯的压力。勒克莱尔勉强守住了第四名，拉塞尔获得第五。
“硬胎绝对是我表现最好的轮胎，”这位英国车手解释道。“如果继续用中性胎留在场上，那会是一场很大的赌博。我当时觉得反正也没什么可输的。到最后，我想结果其实也不会有什么不同。所以，有点遗憾。这条赛道超车非常困难，我想这让所有人都挺郁闷的。”
不过，拉塞尔坚持认为，在马德里赛道上“实际表现远好于最终成绩”。“但这有点像摩纳哥那种感觉，排位赛几乎决定了一切，”他补充道。
与此同时，安东内利拿下了他本赛季的第八场胜利，这也是他在14场大奖赛中的第12次登上领奖台。这位意大利二年级车手对拉塞尔的积分领先优势，在最近五轮比赛中已经从25分扩大到了81分。
拉塞尔痛切地意识到，这位年轻车手的稳定发挥让他在理论上仅剩的九轮比赛里，几乎没有什么余地来实质性缩小争夺总冠军的差距。
“我不会说已经结束了，但我参与这场争夺的可能性极低，”这位28岁的车手承认道。“我甚至没有去想自己还在争夺之中，因为我不认为我还在其中。这几乎反而让我可以专注于每一场比赛，尽力去赢得尽可能多的胜利。该怎样就怎样吧，不过……是的，这就是我们现在的处境。”
detailEn: George Russell closer than ever to giving up on 2026 F1 title
Russell is now 81 points adrift of team-mate Antonelli and is aware nothing short of a miracle can save his title bid
George Russell is now “exceptionally unlikely” to win the 2026 Formula 1 title, having been beaten by Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli for a fifth consecutive time at the Spanish Grand Prix.
Russell qualified a lowly sixth at F1’s new Madring track, explaining he “tried pushing hard in Turn 11” but “the tyres couldn’t take it”.

He and Oscar Piastri made contact at the start of the race, with the Briton seemingly unscathed, but he came off worse with the early virtual safety car as he switched from hard tyres to mediums, while most of his rivals got to move from softs or mediums to hards at an ideal time.

“Just very frustrating timing with the safety car,” Russell said. “We were hoping to make it to lap 40, we knew Kimi and the drivers on the medium and the soft would pit around lap 15, and the safety car came at lap 14, so…”
Only two of the 12 drivers who started on hards did pit under VSC, Russell and Fernando Alonso; the former ended up pitting again to switch back to his preferred hard compound.

Charles Leclerc, who was right ahead of the Mercedes in the early part of the race, stayed out and pitted on lap 48. He still came under pressure from the Mercedes late on, despite the Silver Arrow’s extra pitstop and the new soft tyres on the Ferrari. Leclerc narrowly salvaged fourth, with Russell fifth.

“The hard was by far my most superior tyre,” the Briton explained. “It would have been a big gamble to have stayed out on the medium. I thought I had nothing to lose. In the end, I think I would have ended up where I ended up anyway. So, a bit of a shame. Very tough track to overtake, which was a bit annoying, I guess, for everyone.”
However, Russell insisted that “the performance was far better than the result” in Madrid. “But this was kind of Monaco-esque, in terms of qualifying being everything,” he added.

Meanwhile, Antonelli took his eighth victory of the season and his 12th podium finish in 14 grands prix. The Italian sophomore’s championship lead over Russell has ballooned from 25 to 81 points over the latest five rounds.
Russell is painfully aware that the youngster’s consistency is leaving him with little leeway to meaningfully reduce the gap in the title race, with – theoretically – nine rounds remaining.

“I'm not going to say it's over, but it's exceptionally unlikely that I'm in this fight,” the 28-year-old admitted. “I'm not even thinking about being in the fight because I don't think I am in the fight. It almost just allows me to focus race by race and just try and win as many as possible. What will be, will be, but… Yeah, that's where we are right now.”

items.titleZh: 红牛为要求维斯塔潘让回两个位置的决定辩护
items.summaryZh: 在F1西班牙大奖赛马德里站中，红牛车队指示维斯塔潘让回两个位置，最终他获得第二名。车队负责人Laurent Mekies认为，即便没有这一指令，维斯塔潘也难以取胜。

media.altZh: 红牛为要求维斯塔潘让回两个位置的决定辩护

items.originalTitle: 红牛为要求维斯塔潘让回两个位置的决定辩护
items.summaryEn: In the F1 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, Red Bull instructed Max Verstappen to give back two positions, and he ultimately finished second. Team boss Laurent Mekies believes that even without this instruction, Verstappen would not have been able to win.
detailZh: 红牛为要求维斯塔潘让回两个位置的决定辩护
Laurent Mekies表示，他没想到自己的车手会毫无争辩地服从
维斯塔潘在F1西班牙大奖赛马德里站中获得第二名，仅输给了安东内利——但如果红牛没有指示他在比赛中让出两个位置，他有可能获胜吗？车队负责人Laurent Mekies认为那并不现实。
Verstappen在首圈超越了Antonelli，但当时他已经注定要让回那个位置，因为起步时发生了一起事件。这位荷兰车手曾与汉密尔顿争夺第三名，并在过程中切弯，回到赛道时位于法拉利车手之前。
随后Hamilton通过无线电向他的车队——实际上也向同样能获取无线电的赛事控制中心——指出Verstappen需要让回位置。但那时，这位红牛车手也已经领先于Antonelli了。
他在首圈超越了这位意大利车手，此前这位梅赛德斯车手自己也经历了一个多事的起步，切弯并需要让回一个位置给诺里斯。这意味着如果Verstappen同意让Hamilton通过，他也必须让出一个位置给Antonelli，而后者当时正夹在他们之间。
当Gianpiero Lambiase的指令传来时，Verstappen显然并不认同，辩称Hamilton把他挤出了赛道。
“你们到底在说什么？”他对车队说。“他那样会撞车的。你们到底在说什么？如果我就留在赛道上，我就退赛了。”
尽管如此，Verstappen还是在第四圈执行了指令，让Antonelli和Hamilton都通过了。
正如Mekies所解释的，那时红牛已经分析了这起事件，并决定不值得冒被罚的风险，认为最好立即承受损失，让Verstappen之后再反击。
“看，这永远会是一个痛苦而艰难的决定，但指挥墙上的人非常、非常仔细地看了情况，并迅速做了分析，因为我们必须快速做出决定，”Mekies告诉F1 TV。
安东内利，梅赛德斯，汉密尔顿，法拉利，维斯塔潘，红牛车队，诺里斯，迈凯伦
“当然，我们当时并不期待车里的Max发来‘感谢’邮件，但我们觉得最好在当时承受痛苦，之后再反击，而Max一如既往地做得非常出色，而不是等待并冒更大的处罚风险，那可能在之后代价更高。”
关键在于，红牛并非根据赛事控制中心的指令行事。如果Verstappen保持领先，这起事件将留给赛会干事调查，Mekies表示可能的处罚可能是5秒或10秒。
“赛会干事的决定从来不是让回位置，”他解释道。“那样的话我们只会被罚，要么5秒要么10秒——由他们酌情决定。”
“所以那就是会发生的情况，当然，如果你想象一下有安全车或其他情况的比赛场景，代价可能远不止一两个位置。”
“所以幸运的是，Max在Lewis退赛之前就让出了位置，并最终从那时起继续比赛。当然这令人沮丧，但公平地说，我认为P2是我们今天能取得的最好成绩。”
Hamilton随后的退赛为红牛的决定增添了另一个因素。如果车队将决定推迟到法拉利车手退出比赛之后，Verstappen将不再能够实际把位置还给他。
但Mekies表示，在事件发生期间，红牛几乎没有机会咨询赛事控制中心，车队必须实时做出自己的判断。
“赛后是一个很开放的世界，赛后当然会发生我们与赛事控制中心沟通、也直接与赛会干事沟通以听取他们意见的情况，”他说。
“我相信车队会这样做，因为我们总是交流，总是学习，但在那一刻你没有那么多时间咨询，必须做出决定。”
detailEn: Red Bull defends decision to force Max Verstappen to give back two positions
Laurent Mekies says he didn't expect his driver to simply obey without arguing

Max Verstappen finished second in the Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, losing out only to Kimi Antonelli - yet could he have won had Red Bull not instructed him to concede two positions during the race? Team boss Laurent Mekies believes that wasn't realistic.

Verstappen moved past Antonelli on the opening lap, but by that point he was already doomed to concede that place because of an incident at the start. The Dutchman had battled with Lewis Hamilton for third and cut the corner in the process, emerging back on track ahead of the Ferrari driver.

Hamilton then called on the radio to his team - and effectively race control, which also has access to the feed - to point out that Verstappen needed to give the position back. But by that point, the Red Bull driver was already ahead of Antonelli too.

He had overtaken the Italian during the opening lap, after the Mercedes driver himself had experienced an eventful start to the race, cutting corners and needing to give a position back to Lando Norris. That meant that if Verstappen agreed to let Hamilton through, he would also have to concede a position to Antonelli, who was now between them.
When the call from Gianpiero Lambiase came, Verstappen clearly wasn't in agreement, arguing that Hamilton had pushed him off the track.
"What the f*** are you guys talking about?" he said to the team. "He would've shunted it. Like, what are you guys talking about? If I just stay on the track, I am out of the race."
Verstappen nevertheless followed the instruction on lap four, allowing both Antonelli and Hamilton back through.

As Mekies explained, by that point Red Bull had already analysed the incident and decided it wasn't worth risking a penalty, believing it was better to take the immediate hit and allow Verstappen to fight back.

"Look, it's always going to be a painful and a difficult decision, but the guys on the pit wall had a very, very good look at it and did the analysis fast, because we had to make decisions fast," Mekies told F1 TV.
Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Lando Norris, McLaren

"And of course we were not expecting the 'thank you' email at that moment from Max in the car, but we felt it was better to take the pain at that moment and to fight back after, which Max has done exceptionally well as always, rather than wait and risk bigger penalties that could have been more costly later on."

Crucially, Red Bull was not acting on an instruction from race control. Had Verstappen stayed ahead, the incident would instead have been left for the stewards to investigate, with Mekies saying the potential sanction could have been five or 10 seconds.
"The decision of the stewards is never to give back positions," he explained. "In that case we would have simply been penalised, either five seconds or 10 seconds - it's at their discretion.
"So that's what would have happened and, of course, if you can imagine race scenarios with safety car or other circumstances, it can cost you a lot more than the position or two.

"So luckily Max gave away the positions before Lewis retired and ultimately continued to fight the race from that point. And of course it is frustrating, but in fairness I think P2 was the absolute best we could have achieved today."

Hamilton's subsequent retirement added another element to Red Bull's call. Had the team delayed its decision until after the Ferrari was out of the race, Verstappen would no longer have been able to physically return the position to him.
But Mekies said there was little opportunity for Red Bull to consult race control while the incident was unfolding, with the team having to make its own judgement in real time.
"After the race it's a very open world and after the race, of course, it happens that we speak with race control, that we speak directly with the stewards also to have their opinion," he said.
"And I'm sure it's something that the team will do because we always exchange and we always learn, but at that moment you don't have so much time for consultations and a decision needs to be made."

维斯塔潘起初对车队指令表示异议，但还是在第四圈执行，让Antonelli和Hamilton通过。
Mekies表示，若不立即让位，赛会可能事后处以5或10秒罚时，风险更大。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen overtook Antonelli on the opening lap, but due to cutting the corner while battling Hamilton at the start, he was already doomed to give back the position.
Verstappen initially disagreed with the team order but complied on lap four, allowing both Antonelli and Hamilton through.
Mekies said that without immediately giving back the positions, the stewards could have imposed a five- or ten-second penalty later, which would have been riskier.

items.titleZh: The 比赛评马德里首场F1大奖赛：巨大错失良机
items.summaryZh: The 比赛团队评价马德里首场F1大奖赛并不精彩，认为赛道缺乏超车机会，是一次巨大的错失良机。
items.originalTitle: 马德里首场F1大奖赛：一次巨大的错失良机
items.summaryEn: The Race team reviewed Madrid's first Formula 1 race, calling it not a thriller and a big missed opportunity due to a lack of overtaking opportunities.
detailZh: 马德里的首场F1比赛并不精彩。以下是我们团队对它的看法。
令人费解的是缺乏超车机会
我实在无法理解，为什么在2026年，F1赛道布局在没有明显超车机会的情况下还能获批。
一条全新赛道的魅力在于它是一张白纸，而在马德里，这张白纸被用来打造一条单圈驾驶体验有趣的赛道，以及制造一些F2/F3的混乱，但令人费解的是，为什么没有对F1周日的比赛产品给予更多考虑。
你可以打造世界上最精彩的活动——极佳的粉丝体验、酷炫的地点、一些突出的弯角、便利的交通等等——但如果实际赛道不适合比赛，那这一切都毫无意义。
最糟糕的是，当布局公布时，这一切就完全可以预见，但没有任何利益相关方采取行动。
我很高兴看到F1赛历的最新成员保持了传统——一条几乎不可能超车的赛道。实际上，要如此一贯地做到这一点一定非常困难。
这条赛道对车手来说看起来很有趣，而且它并没有像一些人预测的那样成为撞车盛宴。如果发生事故，他们确实需要找到更快清理赛道的方法——Ollie Bearman在FP3的事故非常清楚地表明了这一点。把车移走没问题，但修复Tecpro护栏非常耗时。
看到几个马歇尔试图把其中一个护栏推到位，而这些护栏的设计是为了抵御一辆900公斤的F1赛车高速行驶时的冲击力，这很滑稽。
这场比赛也凸显了VSC和/或安全车给比赛结果带来的抽奖性质。正如其他车手所说，诺里斯配得上胜利，但当斯特罗尔冲出赛道引发VSC时，胜利从他手中被夺走了。
这很容易解决，那为什么当权者不采取行动呢？
至少它让经典赛道看起来不错
马德里赛道刚刚给了我们一个完美的例子，说明创建一条新赛道有多么困难。
就排位赛单圈对车手的考验而言——哇。它在这方面非常出色。它显然是以‘我们如何让这条赛道成为考验车手并榨取他们最大潜力的绝佳赛道’为前提设计的，这很重要。
但它也有一些设计特征，本不必影响驾驶挑战，却毁了比赛。
让街道赛道变宽从来都不容易，但这条赛道在所有不该窄的地方都很窄。此外，没有足够的‘干净’刹车区，让车手可以在不需要刹车和转向结合的情况下发起真正的进攻。
而且对于一条街道赛道来说，让它不适合F1真的没有借口。这条赛道和这场比赛就是为此而建的。它不是为了让F3或房车赛看起来好看而设计的。
我坐在这里，一边在我卧室里建造我那条比这好得多的史诗级Scalextric赛道，一边扔石头，这很容易。我承认这一点。只是太令人沮丧了，因为感觉这条赛道只需移动几堵墙，再加上几个更平坦、更舒适的刹车区，就能变得绝对完美。
这场比赛艰难的另一个原因？看看它被拿来比较的赛道：澳门。除了从渔人码头到R弯、以及R弯到里斯本弯的长直道外，澳门也很难超车。所以这不是新问题，尽管马德里赛道比澳门固定的道路有更大的灵活性。一次巨大的错失良机。
我倾向于对街道赛道宽容一些。我挺喜欢瓦伦西亚版本的。我喜欢任何让我想起1990年代中期温哥华CART比赛的东西，而那条赛道在比赛和驾驶挑战方面客观来说都很糟糕。我实际上并不认为每条F1赛道都需要明显的超车机会，在一个24场比赛的赛历中，有几个地方一切都必须靠策略或极端的超车创造力来完成，实际上对多样性有好处。
根据我在地同事的报道，马德里作为一项赛事有很多积极之处，从车载和赛道边镜头来看，马德里赛道作为快速单圈的奇观也有很多值得喜欢的地方。
但是……这场比赛太平淡了。像Norris的迈凯伦这样快的赛车在被延误后本应有机会穿越车阵。勒克莱尔不应该在不进站的情况下领先那么久。太多人似乎被困在他们本不必陷入的交通中，这扼杀了比赛中任何引人入胜的希望。
我不认为解决这个问题需要太多。也许甚至只是选择更具侵略性的轮胎配方，而不是调整赛道，就能解决问题。
我喜欢这条赛道，我真的很想享受这场比赛。但我大部分时间都觉得很无聊。
detailEn: Madrid’s first Formula 1 race was not a thriller. Here’s our team’s take on it.
A baffling lack of overtaking opportunities
I can't quite understand why, in 2026, F1 circuit layouts are being approved without featuring any obvious overtaking opportunities.

The beauty of a brand-new circuit is the blank sheet of paper it offers, and while in Madrid it's been used to create an interesting track for a single-lap driving experience, and some F2/F3 chaos, it's baffling why more thought wasn't given to the F1 Sunday product.

You can make the most amazing event in the world - a great fan experience, a cool location, some standout corners, great transport links, etc. - but it means absolutely nothing if the actual circuit isn't good for racing on.
And the worst thing is this was entirely predictable as soon as the layout was revealed, yet nothing was done by any of the stakeholders.

I’m glad to see that the latest addition to the F1 calendar has managed to keep with tradition - a circuit that it is almost impossible to overtake on. In reality it must be very difficult to achieve this so consistently.

The circuit looks like fun for the drivers and it wasn’t the crashfest that some had predicted. If there is an incident they do really need to find a way to clear the track quicker - Ollie Bearman’s accident in FP3 showed that very clearly. Getting the car away was no problem but repairing the Tecpro barriers was very time consuming.
To see a couple of marshals trying to push one of those barriers into place when they are designed to resist the forces of a 900kg Formula 1 car travelling at speed was comical.

This race also highlights what a lottery the VSC and/or safety car brings to the race result. As the other drivers all said, Lando Norris deserved the win but it was taken out of his grasp when Lance Stroll going off brought out the VSC.
It’s simple to fix so why don’t the powers that be do something about it?
At least it makes the classics look good
Madring just gave us the perfect example of why creating a new circuit is so hard.

In terms of a test for the drivers over a qualifying lap - phwoar. It's excellent for that. It's clearly set out with the proviso of 'how do we make this an excellent circuit to test and extract the maximum out of the drivers', and that's important.
But it also has a number of design features that needn't have impacted the driving challenge and ruined the racing.

It's never easy to make a street circuit wide, but this one is narrow in all the wrong places. Plus, there's not enough 'clean' braking zones where drivers can launch proper moves without the need for combined braking and steering.
And there's really no excuse with a street circuit for making it not good for F1. This track and race was built with that in mind. It wasn't designed to make F3 or touring cars look good.

It's easy for me to sit here, throwing stones while creating my epic Scalextrix track that's much better than this, in my bedroom. I acknowledge that. It's just so frustrating because it feels like this track is a few moved walls and a couple of flatter, more comfortable braking zones away from being absolutely mint.

And another reason this one was tough? Look at the track it was compared to: Macau. That's tough to overtake on outside of its long straights from Fishermen's to R, and R to Lisboa. So this isn't a new problem, although the Madring had more flexibility than the set roads of Macau. A big missed opportunity.

I tend to be charitable towards street circuits. I quite liked the Valencia version. I like anything that makes me think of mid-1990s Vancouver CART races and that track was objectively rubbish for both racing and a driving challenge. I don’t actually think every F1 circuit needs clear opportunities and across a 24-race calendar a few places where everything has to be done on strategy or extreme overtaking creativity are actually good for variety.

There are so many positives about Madrid as an event based on the reports from my colleagues on the ground, and watching onboards and trackside footage there was loads to like about Madring as a spectacle on a fast lap too.

But... this race was just too flat. A car as fast as Norris’s McLaren should have had shots at coming through the field once delayed. Charles Leclerc shouldn’t have been able to stay in front that long with no pitstop. Too many people just seemed to be stuck in traffic they needn’t have been in, and that squashed any hope of intrigue in the race.
I don’t think it would take much to sort this. Maybe even just a much more aggressive tyre compound choice rather than circuit tweaks would do the job.
I like this track, I really wanted to enjoy the race. But I spent most of it pretty bored.
keyPointsZh: 赛道布局在2026年获批时就没有明显的超车机会，且这一缺陷在布局公布时就可预见，但利益相关方未采取行动。
Ollie Bearman在FP3的事故暴露出赛道清理效率问题，修复Tecpro护栏耗时过长。
VSC和安全车让比赛结果充满变数，斯特罗尔的失控引发VSC，使诺里斯的胜利被夺走。
keyPointsEn: The circuit layout was approved for 2026 without any obvious overtaking opportunities, a flaw that was entirely predictable when the layout was revealed, yet no stakeholder acted.
Ollie Bearman's FP3 accident exposed slow track clearing, as repairing the Tecpro barriers was very time-consuming.

items.originalTitle: 安东内利赢得马德里首场F1比赛，诺里斯因虚拟安全车错失胜利
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the first-ever Formula 1 race at the Madring, as Lando Norris and McLaren lost a likely victory due to their pitstop timing.
detailZh: 安东内利赢得了在马德里举行的首场F1比赛，而诺里斯和迈凯伦因进站时机问题，错失了本可能到手的胜利。
诺里斯从杆位起步后领先，安东内利只是在第一圈冲出赛道时短暂两次超越他，但两次都将领先位置交还给了诺里斯。
这位迈凯伦车手看起来一直很从容，直到斯特罗尔将他的阿斯顿·马丁停在20号弯的缓冲区。
这触发了虚拟安全车，但诺里斯当时已经通过了维修区入口，而安东内利——以及身后的维斯塔潘和拉塞尔——得以在VSC下进站。
诺里斯晚一圈进站，但比赛已恢复绿旗状态。进站也很慢（7秒），因此他被安东内利、维斯塔潘和拉塞尔超越。
勒克莱尔没有进站，因此他领跑的圈数比任何其他车手都多，直到第48圈（共57圈）才终于换下硬胎，这让安东内利取得领先，并再未让出。
维斯塔潘获得第二名，他在第一圈输给了安东内利。
他在第一圈超越了安东内利和汉密尔顿，跟在诺里斯身后位列第二，但他为了避开汉密尔顿的法拉利而切过第一个减速弯，从而超越了诺里斯。
令维斯塔潘非常不满的是，红牛命令他将位置交还给汉密尔顿——但由于他已经超越了汉密尔顿，他也输给了安东内利。
“他现在可以把位置还给我了，真他妈的扯淡。这他妈的简直是米老鼠比赛，”维斯塔潘当时对车队说道。
汉密尔顿的比赛没过多久就结束了，他因刹车问题退赛。
诺里斯尽管在倒数第二圈攻击了维斯塔潘，但最终只能接受第三名，当时他们正在套圈缠斗中的Arvid Lindblad和霍肯伯格。
维斯塔潘不得不切过减速弯，虽然他因离开赛道并获得优势而被记录，但很快被认定无需进一步调查。
他领先于Leclerc完赛，后者没有得到法拉利所希望的安全车干预。
拉塞尔获得第五名，他第二次进站，并失去了在VSC进站时从诺里斯那里获得的位置。
替补车手劳森获得第六名，这是他迄今为止为红牛取得的最好成绩，领先于科拉平托，后者赢得了F1的中场争夺，甚至击败了迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里。
Lindblad代表小红牛获得第九名，在与Hulkenberg的奥迪的激烈对决中胜出，这是他在四场比赛中第三次获得积分。
除了汉密尔顿和Stroll之外，主场英雄塞恩斯也退赛了——但在此之前，他因与同胞阿隆索发生碰撞而被罚时5秒——Sergio Perez的凯迪拉克也退赛了。
17 阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +2圈
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli won the first-ever Formula 1 race at the Madring, as Lando Norris and McLaren lost a likely victory due to their pitstop timing.
Norris led away from pole, with Antonelli only briefly jumping ahead twice when he ran off the circuit on lap one, before returning the lead to Norris on both occasions.
The McLaren driver was looking comfortable until Lance Stroll brought his Aston Martin to a halt in the run-off area at Turn 20.

That triggered a virtual safety car, but Norris had already passed the pit entry by then, while Antonelli - as well as Max Verstappen and George Russell behind - were able to make their pitstop under the VSC.
Norris pitted a lap later, but the race was back under green flag conditions. The pitstop was slow too (seven seconds), so he was jumped by Antonelli, Verstappen and Russell.

Charles Leclerc didn't pit, so he led more laps of the race than any other driver before finally trading in his hard tyres on lap 48 of 57, allowing Antonelli to claim a race lead he'd never relinquish.
Verstappen finished second, having lost out to Antonelli on the opening lap.
He'd passed him and Lewis Hamilton on the first lap to run second behind Norris, but he overtook the latter by missing the first chicane to avoid Hamilton's Ferrari.
Much to Verstappen's dissatisfaction, Red Bull ordered him to give the place back to Hamilton - but Verstappen lost out to Antonelli too because he'd passed Hamilton.
"He can give me the position now, f***ing bullshit. F***ing mickey-mouse racing this is,” Verstappen told his team at the time.
Hamilton's race didn't last much longer than that as he retired with brake problems.
Norris had to settle for third place despite a penultimate lap attack on Verstappen, while they were lapping a scrapping Arvid Lindblad and Nico Hulkenberg.
Verstappen had to cut a chicane, and while he was noted for leaving the track and gaining an advantage, it was quickly dismissed as needing no further investigation.
He finished ahead of Leclerc, who didn't get the safety car intervention Ferrari was hoping for.
Russell was fifth, having stopped for a second time and lost the position he gained on Norris with his VSC pitstop.
Stand-in Liam Lawson earned his best result for Red Bull so far in sixth place ahead of Franco Colapinto, who won F1's midfield scrap and even beat McLaren's Oscar Piastri.
Lindblad was ninth for Racing Bulls, having triumphed in a tight duel with Hulkenberg's Audi, in the points for the third time in four races.

Along with Hamilton and Stroll, home hero Carlos Sainz retired - but not before picking up a five-second time penalty for clashing with fellow Spaniard Fernando Alonso - as did Sergio Perez's Cadillac.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2 laps
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯从杆位起步并领先，但虚拟安全车出动时他已错过进站入口，而安东内利、维斯塔潘和拉塞尔得以在VSC下进站。
诺里斯下一圈进站，但进站耗时7秒，被安东内利、维斯塔潘和拉塞尔超越。
维斯塔潘因避开汉密尔顿而切过第一个减速弯，被红牛要求交还位置，最终获得第二名。
keyPointsEn: Norris started from pole and led, but when the virtual safety car was deployed he had already passed the pit entry, while Antonelli, Verstappen and Russell were able to pit under the VSC.
Norris pitted a lap later, but the stop took seven seconds and he was jumped by Antonelli, Verstappen and Russell.
Verstappen missed the first chicane to avoid Hamilton, was ordered by Red Bull to give the place back, and finished second.

items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring, benefiting from Lando Norris's pit-stop misfortune during a lap-14 Virtual Safety Car to extend his championship lead to 81 points.
detailZh: 西班牙大奖赛：基米·安东内利赢得F1首届马德里赛道比赛，在兰多·诺里斯遭遇不幸后扩大冠军领先优势
基米·安东内利以本赛季第八场胜利将冠军领先优势扩大至81分；兰多·诺里斯原本看似掌控比赛，却因不合时宜的虚拟安全车失去领先；马克斯·维斯塔潘第二，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿遭遇本赛季首次退赛
2026年西班牙大奖赛集锦
基米·安东内利在争夺2026年世界冠军的道路上再进一步，受益于兰多·诺里斯的进站不幸，赢得了在马德里赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛。
迈凯伦的诺里斯在将出色的杆位转化为比赛早期舒适领先后，原本看似掌控了比赛，但第14圈虚拟安全车的出现改变了胜利争夺，当时阿斯顿马丁的兰斯·斯特罗尔停在缓冲区。
虚拟安全车为全场提供了所谓“廉价”进站的机会，但迈凯伦无法立即让诺里斯进站，因为这位英国人刚刚驶过维修区入口道路。

但紧随其后的安东内利和维斯塔潘尚未通过，这使得梅赛德斯和红牛可以分别让他们的车手进站，而诺里斯则在赛道上以受控的降低速度行驶，同时马歇尔正在移动斯特罗尔的赛车。
迈凯伦确实在下一圈结束时让诺里斯进站，但那时虚拟安全车已经结束，意味着全场已恢复比赛速度，而这次不幸又因换胎时长达七秒的缓慢服务而雪上加霜。
兰多·诺里斯在一系列不幸事件后失去比赛领先，他在虚拟安全车期间错过了进站机会，随后迈凯伦又进行了一次非常缓慢的进站。
诺里斯以第五名重新加入比赛，并凭借惊人的速度最终以第三名紧追第二名的维斯塔潘，但在最后几圈中始终无法找到超越红牛的方法。
由于乔治·拉塞尔在第二辆梅赛德斯中仅获得第五名，落后于长时间领跑的查尔斯·勒克莱尔的法拉利，安东内利的冠军领先优势在剩余九场比赛的情况下扩大至赛季最高的81分。
安东内利说：“我认为今天获胜是好事，但感觉没那么好，因为我认为兰多今天配得上胜利，但总的来说，我们接受了。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在西班牙大奖赛被迫提前退赛
法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿现在落后101分，几乎退出争夺，因为他在赛车于七圈内遭遇致命刹车问题后，经历了本赛季首次退赛。
利亚姆·劳森为红牛获得第六名，阿尔派的弗兰科·科拉平托第七，领先于第二辆迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。小红牛的阿尔维德·林德布拉德第九，奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格第十。
“我们太快了，仅此而已”——不走运的诺里斯的速度如何导致了他的不幸
在第14圈虚拟安全车启动之前，诺里斯似乎正准备重现他最近在匈牙利赛道和赞德福特的主导性胜利，他领先梅赛德斯的安东内利六秒。
这位卫冕世界冠军在比赛起步时受到冠军领先者的攻击，但安东内利很快陷入被动，因为他在刹车时切过了第一个减速弯。这让意大利人在出弯时取得领先，但他显然必须将位置交还给诺里斯，他迅速照做了。
基米·安东内利在西班牙大奖赛首圈两次跑宽
安东内利试图在接下来的五、六号减速弯再次从迈凯伦外侧绕过，但不得不再次放弃，又一次切过缓冲区。但当他第二次让诺里斯通过时，他无法阻止维斯塔潘也在七号弯跟进，因此跌至第三。
但安东内利很快又回到维斯塔潘前面，因为红牛告诉他们的车手退到意大利人和汉密尔顿后面，此前维斯塔潘在一号弯跑出赛道超越了后者。维斯塔潘在车队无线电中对这一事件解读提出异议，称他别无选择只能跑宽，但他服从了命令。
与此同时，诺里斯迅速开始建立领先优势，当维斯塔潘在第四圈退后时，他已经领先安东内利3.2秒。
兰多·诺里斯承认在错过关键的虚拟安全车进站后，车队“太快了”，这让他失去了比赛领先
这位英国人在第九圈时领先五秒，当虚拟安全车启动时，他的领先优势又扩大了一秒。最终，这种超凡的速度成为诺里斯的致命伤，因为他已经过了维修区入口，无法立即进站，而幸运的追赶者们则没有，因此可以进站。
赛后诺里斯在车队无线电中说：“只能接受。我们太快了，仅此而已。今天非常不走运，伙计们，我们本应该赢的。”
迈凯伦首席执行官扎克·布朗表示同意，他对天空体育 F1说：“那场比赛本属于我们，领先20或25秒。”
“他占据主导，他消失了。管理得当，轮胎磨损出色——独一档。”
现在冠军争夺中还有什么能阻止安东内利吗？
由于诺里斯在延迟且缓慢的进站后回到赛道时最初排在拉塞尔之后的第五位，随后梅赛德斯第二次进站，尽管还有40圈，安东内利的胜利似乎几乎不可避免。
然而，这位意大利人实际上直到第48圈结束才领先比赛，因为法拉利让勒克莱尔用硬胎留在外面，希望会有另一次虚拟或全场安全车干预。但没有出现。

detailEn: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins F1's first Madring race to increase title lead after Lando Norris misfortune

Kimi Antonelli increased his championship lead to a commanding 81 points with his eighth race win of the year; Lando Norris appeared to have race under control before untimely Virtual Safety Car lost him the lead; Max Verstappen second, while Lewis Hamilton suffered first DNF of his season
Highlights from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli took another step in his quest towards winning the 2026 world championship by benefitting from pit-stop misfortune for Lando Norris to win the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring.

McLaren's Norris had looked in control of the race after converting his superb pole position into a comfortable early race lead but the battle for victory turned on a lap-14 Virtual Safety Car when Aston Martin's Lance Stroll stopped in a run-off area.
With a VSC offering the field the chance of a so-called 'cheap' pit stop, McLaren were unable to pit Norris immediately as the Briton had just passed the pit-lane entry road.

But the following Antonelli and Verstappen had not, allowing Mercedes and Red Bull to pit their drivers respectively while Norris was running to a controlled reduced speed on track while marshals moved Stroll's car.

McLaren did pit Norris at the end of the next lap but, by then, the VSC had ended, meaning the field was back up to racing speed, with that misfortune then compounded by a slow seven-second service at the tyre change.
Lando Norris lost the race lead after an unlucky sequence of events which saw a missed a pitstop opportunity under a VSC, followed by a very slow stop by McLaren

Norris rejoined in fifth place and, underlining his prodigious pace, eventually finished on second-placed Verstappen's tail in third but was tantalisingly unable to find a way past the Red Bull through the closing laps.

With George Russell finishing only fifth in the second Mercedes behind a long-running Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, Antonelli's title lead grows to a season-high 81 points with a scheduled nine races remaining.
Antonelli said: "I think today it's good to win but it doesn't feel as good because I think Lando today deserved the win but overall, we take it."
Lewis Hamilton was forced to retire early at the Spanish Grand Prix
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is now 101 points back and all but out of contention after he suffered his first race retirement of the season after his car ran into terminal brake issues inside seven laps.
Liam Lawson was sixth for Red Bull with Alpine's Franco Colapinto seventh ahead of Oscar Piastri in the second McLaren. Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad was ninth with Audi's Nico Hulkenberg in 10th.
'We were too quick, that's all it was' - How luckless Norris' speed led to his misfortune

Before the VSC was initiated on lap 14, Norris appeared to be shaping up for a repeat of his dominant recent wins at the Hungaroring and Zandvoort as he raced into a lead of six seconds over Mercedes' Antonelli.

The reigning world champion had come under attack from the championship leader at the race start but Antonelli was soon on the back foot when he cut the first chicane under braking. It put the Italian into the lead on the exit, but he clearly had to give the place back to Norris, which he swiftly did.
Kimi Antonelli found himself going wide twice on the opening lap of the Spanish Grand Prix

Antonelli attempted to go around the outside of the McLaren again into the next chicane at turns five-six but had to bail out of it once more, again cutting across the run-off. But when he let Norris through for a second time, he was unable to prevent Verstappen following through too at turn seven and so dropped to third.

But Antonelli was soon back ahead of Verstappen after Red Bull told their driver to drop back both behind the Italian and Hamilton having jumped the latter back at turn one by running off track. Verstappen disputed that interpretation of events over team radio, saying he had no choice but to run wide, but heeded the order.
Norris, meanwhile, had quickly set about building a lead and was already 3.2 ahead of Antonelli when Verstappen dropped back on lap four.
Lando Norris admits team 'were too quick' after missing a crucial VSC pit stop that cost him race lead

The Briton was five seconds clear by lap nine and his lead had grown the lead by a further second by the time the VSC was initiated. In the end, that supreme speed proved to be Norris' undoing, as he was already beyond the pit entry so could not pit immediately whereas his fortunate pursuers were not and so could.
Speaking on team radio after the race, Norris said: "Just take it on the chin. We were too quick, that's all. Very unlucky today guys, we should have won."
McLaren chief executive Zak Brown concurred, telling Sky Sports F1: "That was our race by 20 or 25 seconds.
"He was dominant, he was gone. Managing, great tyre wear - a league of his own."
Is there now any stopping Antonelli in the title chase?

With Norris returning to the track after his delayed and then slow stop initially behind Russell in fifth place before the Mercedes pitted for a second time, a victory for Antonelli appeared almost inevitable despite there still being 40 laps to go.

However, the Italian did not actually lead the race until the end of lap 48 as Ferrari kept Leclerc out on hard tyres in the hope of their being another Virtual or full Safety Car intervention. There was not.
Kimi Antonelli admitted it wasn't the way he wanted to win and that Lando Norris deserved the Spanish GP victory
